name: Tab navigator
description:
1. Issue: when a workspace is opened, `AppWindow` loads `lastUrl` or falls back to the original `app.path`; the `AppIcon` menu's "home" button failed to return to that original path.
2. Root cause traced: workspace panels store the payload as `params.workspace` (which holds `path`), but `AppIcon.baseUrl` only checked `path` and `params.path` — both absent for workspaces — so "home" resolved to `null` and did nothing.
3. Fix applied in a single file, `src/components/apps/AppIcon.vue`, by adding a `workspaceApp` computed and extending `baseUrl` to read `params.workspace.path`.
4. This aligns `AppIcon` with `AppWindow.theApp` (same source) and guarantees "home" always targets the original `app.path`, since navigation only writes `lastUrl`.
5. Non-workspace apps keep their existing resolution order, so there is no behavior change for them.

## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core Requirements** - Add a **home** (fontawesome) control to the app menu URL navigator that navigates the app back to its **base URL** — i.e. the app's configured `path` (what it was opened with), discarding any `lastUrl` reached by browsing. - It must only appear inside the existing URL navigator block (apps without a URL get nothing). **Strategic Approach** 1. The base URL of an app is `app.path`. Add a `baseUrl` computed exposing exactly that. 2. Add a small icon button (house icon) at the **left** of the address input: it sets the address input to the base URL and pushes `{ lastUrl: baseUrl }` through the existing `$ui.updateAppParams` channel — the same one used by the Go button and by `AppWindow.persistUrl`. 3. `AppWindow.vue already watches `liveApp.params.lastUrl`, so pushing the base URL there is enough to actually re-navigate the iframe. No other file needs changing. 4. Disable the home button when the app has no `path` (nothing to return to). **Dependencies & Risks** - Pure additive change to one file. Reuses the working `updateAppParams` → `AppWindow` watcher path already in place. - Guard `@click.stop` / `@keydown.stop` stays on the wrapping `div`, so the menu typeahead isn't disturbed. - When already on the base URL, we still refresh the input value but skip the (no-op) store write — consistent with `openUrl`. **Target Files** | File | Action | | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/apps/AppIcon.vue` | Modify — add a `home` (house) button + `baseUrl` computed + `openBaseUrl` method | ## 2.
